=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:312-319 (mirrored .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:557-559; job timeouts update_workflows.yml:55-56, workflow_integrity.yml:36-37) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The clamp `[ "$(( 10#${SMF_MAX_WAIT} ))" -le 1500 ] || SMF_MAX_WAIT=1500` allows up to 1500 s of rate-limit sleep under the 30-minute update-wrappers timeout. That leaves about 300 s for work the cap does not count: the pre-verify fetch, gh attempt latency, the two 10 s generic retries, gh attestation verify, and the post-verify sync and PR delivery.
  WHY: When SYNC_MANIFEST_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECONDS is raised toward 1500 and the reset is about 24-25 minutes away, the job can hit its timeout instead of ending in the classified `ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_FETCH_FAILED detail=rate_limited`, which contradicts the comment at lines 317-319. The default of 1200 is not affected. All reviewers rated it NIT. They disagree on the integrity copy: the claude reviewer says the 35-minute timeout there is fine, while luna notes it leaves 10 minutes.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:426-427 (mirrored .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:664-667) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The SMF_ASSET_ID jq lookup suppresses parse errors with `|| true`, so a malformed release JSON body produces an empty asset ID, which is reported as `ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_MISSING`.
  WHY: A 200 response with a corrupt or non-JSON body is misclassified as a missing manifest instead of a fetch or response-format failure. It stays fail-safe because attestation still catches tampered bytes. All reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: Add ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_FETCH_FAILED with its detail= values, the SYNC_MANIFEST_FETCH log line, the env var and its default, and the narrowed meaning of ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_MISSING. to agents.md via agents.d/.
  expected_change_site: agents.d/9937-sync-manifest-fetch-retry.md
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

The anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash reviewers dispute this: they say agents.d/9937-sync-manifest-fetch-retry.md line 7 documents `detail=release_not_found`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:line 56 `timeout-minutes: 30`; lines 317-319 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The clamp `[ "$(( 10#${SMF_MAX_WAIT} ))" -le 1500 ] || SMF_MAX_WAIT=1500` lets rate-limit sleeps reach 1500 s, which leaves only 300 s of the 30-minute job budget. That 300 s must cover the upstream fetch, gh attempt latency, the two 10 s generic retries (not counted in SMF_WAITED), gh attestation verify, and the sync, staging and PR delivery. The workflow_integrity.yml copy, with its 35-minute timeout, is fine.
  WHY: With the variable set between about 1300 and 99999 and the reset about 24-25 minutes away, GitHub cancels the job at 30 minutes instead of the run ending in the classified `ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_FETCH_FAILED detail=rate_limited`. The default of 1200 is not affected. Suggested fix: lower the clamp to 1200 in both copies, in the `test_update_job_timeout_covers_rate_limit_wait` assertion and in the agents.d and changelog fragments, or raise update-wrappers to 35 minutes. This is repeated as a hardening suggestion (4-6 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. The reviewer refutes the pass-1 `detail=release_not_found` gap, which is documented in agents.d/9937-sync-manifest-fetch-retry.md. It says the other `gh release download` sites claim does not hold (no matches on the current ref) and is outside issue #9937's scope.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml and .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:~426 and ~664 (in SMF_ASSET_ID extraction) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: jq parse errors are suppressed with || true, so a jq failure is reported as ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_MISSING.
  WHY: A malformed or invalid JSON response leaves SMF_ASSET_ID empty, and the run is misclassified as ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_MISSING instead of the underlying error.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml and .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:~312 and ~558 (the clamp logic) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The clamp `[ "$(( 10#${SMF_MAX_WAIT} ))" -le 1500 ] || SMF_MAX_WAIT=1500` allows up to 25 minutes of waiting under timeout-minutes: 30, which leaves little headroom for the pre-verify fetch and checkout, gh attestation verify, and the post-verify sync and PR work.
  WHY: When the Retry-After or reset wait approaches 25 minutes, the job can end in an unclassified timeout instead of the ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_FETCH_FAILED rejection.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Add ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_FETCH_FAILED with its detail= values, the SYNC_MANIFEST_FETCH log line, the env var and its default, and the narrowed meaning of ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_MISSING. to agents.md via agents.d/.
  Expected change site: agents.d/9937-sync-manifest-fetch-retry.md
  Evidence of absence: The fragment exists and documents the narrowed ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_MISSING in general terms, but does not explicitly document the detail=release_not_found mapping.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:317-319, 55-56; workflow_integrity.yml:557-559, 36-37 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The 1500-second maximum rate-limit wait leaves only 5 minutes of the 30-minute updater timeout, and 10 minutes of the 35-minute integrity timeout, for the remaining work. That allowance does not include request latency or the non-rate-limit retry delays.
  WHY: The job can time out before the fetch block returns a classified rejection or the workflow completes, which contradicts the nearby comment about the clamp.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:426-427; workflow_integrity.yml:666-667 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `jq` parse errors are suppressed with `|| true`, and the resulting empty asset ID is reported as `ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_MISSING`.
  WHY: A successful release lookup that returns malformed JSON is reported as a missing manifest asset instead of a fetch or response-format failure.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:line 319 (mirrored byte-identically at .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:559); job timeouts at update_workflows.yml:56 and workflow_integrity.yml:37 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The clamp `[ "$(( 10#${SMF_MAX_WAIT} ))" -le 1500 ] || SMF_MAX_WAIT=1500` permits 1500 s of sleep under the 30-minute timeout. That leaves about 300 s for the work the cap does not count: the pre-verify fetch and checkout, up to six `gh api` attempt latencies, two 10 s generic retries, `gh attestation verify`, and the post-verify sync and PR work. The comment at lines 317-318 is therefore false.
  WHY: The job is killed at 30 minutes during attestation or the post-verify work, so the alert and Summary steps see a cancelled or timed-out job instead of `reject ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_FETCH_FAILED detail=rate_limited`. The default of 1200 is not affected.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:lines 426-427 (mirrored byte-identically at .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:666-667) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `SMF_ASSET_ID="$(jq -r ... 2>/dev/null || true)"` discards jq's exit status, so a malformed body yields an empty asset ID and falls through to `reject ERR_SYNC_MANIFEST_MISSING`.
  WHY: A 200 response with a corrupt body is misreported as a missing manifest, with the wrong reason code in the alert and Summary. It stays safe because attestation still catches tampered bytes.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. The reviewer refutes the gemini gap: agents.d/9937-sync-manifest-fetch-retry.md:7 documents `detail=release_not_found`. It treats the `gh release download` sites in `verify_release_manifest` (~lines 541-563 and ~2398) as out of scope, a follow-up rather than a gap.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
